# TaxDesk OS

> Open-source practice management and ITR preparation system for Indian CA (Chartered Accountant) and tax offices, built by Aryan Madaan. Next.js 15, React 19, strict TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL with row-level security). Apache-2.0.

TaxDesk OS is a staff-only operations tool: clients, cases (ITR, IEPF, GST, registrations), document checklists, expiring client upload links, physical document custody, fees, PDF generation and WhatsApp follow-up templates. Its Tax Desk is an ITR-preparation workspace built on a pure, deterministic, versioned AY 2026-27 income tax engine (new regime 115BAC and old regime, 87A rebate, surcharge with marginal relief, cess, senior citizens, 44AD/44ADA presumptive income, house property, capital gains with CII indexation, 80C/80D/80G deductions). Every rule cites committed statutory text extracts; computations are immutable snapshots; validation, eligibility gates, qualified-reviewer sign-off and filing readiness control the path to internal finalization. It never logs into government portals and never files returns.
